summary: Add scripts/smoke-install.mjs: pack -> install -> generated shim -> chain-load smoke test; wire into CI windows lane.

per.section: 3. Install smoke test — pack → install → shim → chain load

new.description: Plain-Node script per §3: npm pack repo, install tarball into fs.mkdtemp scratch dir, run generated shim (flume.cmd on win32, flume elsewhere) --version expect 0, scaffold minimal chain fixture, run shim's render <phase> expect 0. Print each step; abort non-zero on first failing step, naming it.

edit.description: wire smoke:install into the existing windows-latest lane per §3 (no new lane needed — one already exists).

acceptance: pnpm run smoke:install exits 0 on this win32 machine, log shows both --version and render passing through the .cmd shim; CI windows lane runs it green.
notes: Depends on NODE-BIN-ENTRY shipping first — otherwise the --version step fails against the known-bad sh.exe shim, which is the exact defect this test exists to catch.

summary: Add 0.6.1 CHANGELOG section: Fixed (Windows bin) and Added (smoke:install).
